deadline.value: Fall applications are due January 15; the department starts reviewing in early February.
deadline.quote: Applications for our graduate program are due on January 15 for fall applications

fee_waiver.value: The department does not waive its fee; a waiver is possible only through the Graduate School open house, and the application page says the fee cannot be waived.
fee_waiver.quote: There may be an opportunity to obtain a fee waiver if you attend the Graduate School Open House

also.quote: This fee is non-refundable and cannot be waived.

gre_general.value: The GRE is no longer a prerequisite for admission.
gre_general.quote: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE) is no longer a prerequisite for admission.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: No research advisor needs to be secured before applying; the department suggests naming faculty in the reason statement.
supervisor.quote: No, this is not necessary, but you are welcome to contact our faculty anytime.

funding.value: All new students get a TA in year one, then most are supported by a TA or RA while in good standing, for up to five years.
funding.quote: All new graduate students are offered a Teaching Assistantship (TA) for their first year on campus. | After that, graduate students are typically supported by a Teaching or Research Assistantship (RA)

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether a master's is needed.

notes: The department requires an elevated speaking score for TA eligibility (FAQ question 17); the numbers are not on the pages fetched, so the TOEFL/IELTS fields use the Graduate School values. Applicants below the speaking score must pass MITAA on arrival.
